title: Symbol extraction
definition: Functions, classes and methods are parsed out of source files into named nodes with a kind and a line span
counts_as_has: a parser pass (tree-sitter or AST walk) that stores one record per symbol with its file and lines

title: Multi-language parsing
definition: Source in several programming languages is parsed by per-language grammars or queries
counts_as_has: at least five languages each with its own grammar, query file or extractor module registered in one dispatch

title: Signatures and docstrings
definition: Each symbol keeps its signature, parameters or return type and its doc comment
counts_as_has: stored fields for signature or doc text on the symbol record, filled by the parser

title: Visibility and modifiers
definition: Public, private, async, static or export status is recorded per symbol
counts_as_has: a stored visibility or modifier field set by the parser and used in a query or output

title: Test detection
definition: Test functions and test files are recognised and marked
counts_as_has: code that tags symbols or files as tests from naming, decorators or paths and stores or filters on the tag

title: Call graph
definition: Which symbol calls which, kept as edges that can be queried both ways
counts_as_has: stored caller-callee edges plus a query for callers or callees

title: Import graph
definition: Which file or module imports which other
counts_as_has: stored import or dependency edges between files or modules

title: Inheritance and implements edges
definition: Class extends, interface implements and trait impl relations are stored as edges
counts_as_has: stored edges for extends or implements, and a query or output that reads them

title: Cross-file call resolution
definition: A call is resolved to the definition in another file, not only matched by name
counts_as_has: a resolver that uses imports, scope or type information to link a call to a definition in a different file

title: Community detection
definition: Symbols or files are clustered into modules from the graph alone
counts_as_has: a clustering step (connected components, Leiden or similar) whose result is stored and labelled

title: Type and reference edges
definition: References to types, fields and constants are stored beyond calls
counts_as_has: stored edges of kind references, uses-type or reads/writes between symbols and types or data

title: Full-text search
definition: Symbol names and text are searchable by keyword with ranking
counts_as_has: an inverted index (FTS5 or similar) queried by a search command or tool

title: Embedding search
definition: Symbols are searched by meaning through vector embeddings
counts_as_has: embeddings computed for symbols or chunks and a nearest-neighbour query over them

title: Fuzzy and partial name lookup
definition: A symbol is found from a partial, misspelt or differently-cased name
counts_as_has: code that ranks symbol names by prefix, substring, edit distance or trigram match

title: Structural or regex pattern search
definition: Code is searched by a regex or an AST-shaped pattern, not only by words
counts_as_has: a command or tool that takes a regex or syntax pattern and returns matching code locations

title: MCP server
definition: The index is served to coding agents over the Model Context Protocol
counts_as_has: a command that starts an MCP server exposing query tools

title: Command-line interface
definition: Indexing and queries run from a terminal command with subcommands
counts_as_has: an argument parser with at least index and query subcommands that print results

title: HTTP or web UI
definition: The index is served over HTTP or visualised in a browser
counts_as_has: a server listening on a port that answers graph queries or serves an interactive view

title: Editor or agent hooks
definition: The tool plugs into an editor or a coding-agent hook so it runs without being asked
counts_as_has: an extension project, hook script or installer for an editor or agent that calls the tool

title: Multi-repo registry
definition: Several repositories are indexed side by side and queried by name
counts_as_has: a registry or workspace of repos with per-repo selection in queries

title: Incremental update
definition: Re-indexing touches only files that changed
counts_as_has: change detection by hash, mtime or git diff that skips unchanged files

title: Watch mode
definition: The index follows file changes live without a manual re-run
counts_as_has: a file-system watcher or git hook that triggers re-indexing on change

title: Ignore rules
definition: Files are skipped by gitignore-style rules and size or language limits
counts_as_has: code that reads ignore files or configured globs and excludes matches from indexing

title: Export formats
definition: The graph can be written out for other tools
counts_as_has: a command that writes JSON, markdown or another documented format

title: Graph visualisation
definition: The graph is rendered as a picture or diagram
counts_as_has: code that emits DOT, Mermaid, SVG, HTML or similar for graph nodes and edges

title: Impact analysis
definition: Given a changed symbol or file, the callers and dependants it affects are listed
counts_as_has: a query that walks edges backwards from a symbol or diff to a set of affected symbols

title: Diff or PR review context
definition: The tool turns a git diff or pull request into the symbols touched and their surroundings
counts_as_has: code that reads a git diff or PR and maps changed lines to symbols plus related context

title: Dead code and cycles
definition: Unreferenced symbols or circular dependencies are reported
counts_as_has: a query or command that lists symbols with no inbound edges or cycles in the import graph

title: Complexity and hotspot metrics
definition: Per-symbol metrics such as cyclomatic complexity, size or churn are computed
counts_as_has: code that computes and stores or reports a numeric metric per symbol or file

title: Context bundle for a task
definition: One call returns the relevant code, callers and docs for a task within a token budget
counts_as_has: a tool or command that assembles symbols, source and relations into one output bounded by a size or token limit

counts_as_has: an inverted index (FTS5 or similar) queried by a search command or tool

title: Embedding search
definition: Symbols are searched by meaning through vector embeddings
counts_as_has: embeddings computed for symbols or chunks and a nearest-neighbour query over them

title: Fuzzy and partial name lookup
definition: A symbol is found from a partial, misspelt or differently-cased name
counts_as_has: code that ranks symbol names by prefix, substring, edit distance or trigram match

title: Structural or regex pattern search
definition: Code is searched by a regex or an AST-shaped pattern, not only by words
counts_as_has: a command or tool that takes a regex or syntax pattern and returns matching code locations

title: MCP server
definition: The index is served to coding agents over the Model Context Protocol
counts_as_has: a command that starts an MCP server exposing query tools

title: Command-line interface
definition: Indexing and queries run from a terminal command with subcommands
counts_as_has: an argument parser with at least index and query subcommands that print results

title: HTTP or web UI
definition: The index is served over HTTP or visualised in a browser
counts_as_has: a server listening on a port that answers graph queries or serves an interactive view

title: Editor or agent hooks
definition: The tool plugs into an editor or a coding-agent hook so it runs without being asked
counts_as_has: an extension project, hook script or installer for an editor or agent that calls the tool

title: Multi-repo registry
definition: Several repositories are indexed side by side and queried by name
counts_as_has: a registry or workspace of repos with per-repo selection in queries

title: Incremental update
definition: Re-indexing touches only files that changed
counts_as_has: change detection by hash, mtime or git diff that skips unchanged files

title: Watch mode
definition: The index follows file changes live without a manual re-run
counts_as_has: a file-system watcher or git hook that triggers re-indexing on change

title: Ignore rules
definition: Files are skipped by gitignore-style rules and size or language limits
counts_as_has: code that reads ignore files or configured globs and excludes matches from indexing

title: Export formats
definition: The graph can be written out for other tools
counts_as_has: a command that writes JSON, markdown or another documented format

title: Graph visualisation
definition: The graph is rendered as a picture or diagram
counts_as_has: code that emits DOT, Mermaid, SVG, HTML or similar for graph nodes and edges

title: Impact analysis
definition: Given a changed symbol or file, the callers and dependants it affects are listed
counts_as_has: a query that walks edges backwards from a symbol or diff to a set of affected symbols

title: Diff or PR review context
definition: The tool turns a git diff or pull request into the symbols touched and their surroundings
counts_as_has: code that reads a git diff or PR and maps changed lines to symbols plus related context

title: Dead code and cycles
definition: Unreferenced symbols or circular dependencies are reported
counts_as_has: a query or command that lists symbols with no inbound edges or cycles in the import graph

title: Complexity and hotspot metrics
definition: Per-symbol metrics such as cyclomatic complexity, size or churn are computed
counts_as_has: code that computes and stores or reports a numeric metric per symbol or file

title: Context bundle for a task
definition: One call returns the relevant code, callers and docs for a task within a token budget
counts_as_has: a tool or command that assembles symbols, source and relations into one output bounded by a size or token limit
